hero.title: One workflow from source string to shipped translation.
hero.lead: Lingrove replaces file exports, vendor portals and status spreadsheets with a single system that your engineers, linguists and managers all trust.

modules.title: Your repository is the source of truth.
modules.body: Lingrove reads the file formats you already use and writes back through pull requests, so nothing bypasses code review.
points: JSON, YAML, XLIFF, PO, ARB, Android and iOS strings
Branch-aware: translate feature branches before they merge
Automatic pull requests with a changelog per locale

modules.title: Say it once. Reuse it everywhere.
modules.body: Approved translations become reusable assets. Glossary terms are enforced for every translator, every vendor and every machine engine.
points: Fuzzy matching with context from neighbouring strings
Import existing memories from TMX in minutes

modules.title: Catch the bug before your customers do.
modules.body: Automated checks run on every segment, so reviewers spend their time on meaning, not on broken placeholders.
points: Length limits from your design system
Custom rules for tone, punctuation and brand terms

integrations.title: Fits the stack you already run.

security.title: Enterprise controls, without the enterprise friction.

items.title: SSO & SCIM
items.body: SAML single sign-on with automatic provisioning and de-provisioning.

items.title: Data residency
items.body: Choose EU or US hosting per workspace. Content never leaves its region.

items.title: Audited annually
items.body: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, with reports available under NDA.

items.title: Full audit trail
items.body: Every edit, approval and export is logged and exportable.
